downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: Download the latest version of spark.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.description: Read the documentation and usage guides.

about.heading: About
about.intro: spark is a performance profiler, made up of three main components.
about.links: More information about spark can be found on <github>GitHub</github>, or you can come chat with us on <discord>Discord</discord>.

profiler.title: Profiler
profiler.description: spark can help to diagnose performance problems and bottlenecks with its built-in profiler.

memory.title: Memory Inspection
memory.description: spark can produce full heap dumps, present a summary of what’s using the most memory, and monitor GC activity.

health.title: Health Reporting
health.description: spark monitors and reports a number of key metrics which are useful for tracking performance over time.

viewer.heading: Viewer
viewer.intro: This website is also an online viewer for spark data.

steps.step1: Generate a <profile>profile</profile> or <heapSummary>heap summary</heapSummary> using the appropriate spark commands.
steps.step2: After the data has been uploaded, click the link to open the viewer.

viewer.localFiles: You can also generate or export a .sparkprofile or .sparkheap file and open it by dragging it into the box below.
viewer.opensource: The website/viewer is written in JavaScript using the React framework, and open-source'd on GitHub. Pull requests are much appreciated!

otherPlatforms.title: Other Platforms
otherPlatforms.intro: spark is also available for some other platforms. These releases are provided as-is and are supported by the community. For more info, please see <link>spark-extra-platforms</link> on GitHub.
